name: Integris Medtech
summary: Integris Medtech makes cardiovascular devices such as drug-eluting stents and supplies laboratory equipment, reagents and services under the BioCal brand, with plants in India, Germany and the Netherlands and about two-thirds of revenue from outside India. Revenue grew from ₹1,348 cr in FY23 to ₹1,902 cr in FY25 and the company swung from a ₹4.9 cr loss to a ₹70.7 cr profit in FY25, but ROE was only 5.35% and borrowings tripled over the period. About ₹510 cr, or 85% of the ₹600 cr fresh issue, goes to repaying subsidiaries' borrowings, with nothing for new capacity, and the promoter Evercure Holdings is selling 1.08 crore shares. The price band was not announced when this was researched, so valuation checks are not rated and all figures come from the DRHP and its October 2026 addendum, not an RHP.

checks.name: Revenue growth
checks.finding: Revenue from operations rose from ₹1,348.1 cr (FY23) to ₹1,902.5 cr (FY25), a CAGR of about 18.8%.

checks.name: Revenue rose every year
checks.finding: Revenue grew every year: ₹1,348 cr, ₹1,553 cr, ₹1,902 cr (FY23–FY25).

checks.name: Debt to equity
checks.finding: Debt to equity was about 0.20 at June 2025 (borrowings ₹793.4 cr vs net worth ₹3,890.0 cr).

checks.name: Debt growing slower than revenue
checks.finding: Borrowings rose 211% (₹556.5 cr to ₹1,729.5 cr) while revenue rose 41% over FY23–FY25; they fell to ₹793.4 cr by June 2025.

checks.name: Net worth rising
checks.finding: Net worth rose every year: ₹2,629.5 cr, ₹2,681.0 cr, ₹2,752.5 cr (FY23–FY25).

checks.name: Positive operating cash flow
checks.finding: Operating cash flow was ₹155.5 cr in FY25, more than twice the ₹70.7 cr profit.

checks.name: Profit growth
checks.finding: Profit after tax turned from a ₹4.9 cr loss in FY24 to a ₹70.7 cr profit in FY25.

checks.name: Profit margin trend
checks.finding: Net margin improved from losses in FY23 (−₹40.5 cr) and FY24 (−₹4.9 cr) to 3.72% in FY25.

checks.name: Return on equity
checks.finding: ROE was 5.35% in FY25 (RoNW 1.48%).

checks.name: Return on capital employed
checks.finding: ROCE was 14.51% in FY25.

checks.finding: Tax and regulatory claims against subsidiaries total about ₹17.5 cr, under 1% of the ₹3,890 cr net worth.

checks.name: Criminal or regulatory cases
checks.finding: One regulatory proceeding against promoters (₹15.09 cr) is paid in full and awaiting closure; no criminal cases against the company are reported.
